name: create_above_beyond
description: Docker Container for Create Above & Beyond Minecraft Modpack The docker on first run will download the same version as tagged of Create Above & Beyond and install it. This can take a while as the Forge installer can take a bit to complete. You can watch the logs and it will eventually finish. After the first run it will simply start the server.

paths.name: Installed Location
paths.description: Path to store the installed server files.
